phase_note: Amended 2026-07-25 after cross-spec review; approvals retained (requirements.md/design.md Amendment 1). Five user-approved rulings applied. (1) BLOCKING: this spec's ProfileView.load_settings workaround is WITHDRAWN — training-load Amendment 3 adds LoadContext(activity_date, settings) to compute's parameter list, so ProfileView reverts to a pure benchmark-store view and sheds activity_date and staleness_window_days. Task 1.3 is withdrawn (it added the member, the AthleteProfile field and the apply_load binding); load/types.py, load/profile.py and load/engine.py are no longer modified by this feature; the CalculatorConfigAccess component is removed and its coverage (1.6, 5.3) moves to task 3.3, whose _Depends_ edge repoints 1.3 -> 1.2. The previously recorded ProfileView.staleness_window_days redundancy is restated as RESOLVED upstream, not carried. (2) BLOCKING: load-channels fixed the heart-rate intensity defect (HR now reports sqrt(impulse_ratio), so load == hours x intensity^2 x 100 holds identically on all three channels within 1e-9 relative); this spec's single ('Intensity', ...) inputs_used label is therefore honest across channels, which is now stated explicitly at ResultAssembly and pinned by new criterion 8.11, with a revalidation trigger if the semantic changes. (3) activity-qa-flags Req 8's name-your-basis rule extended here: the coverage input reads 'distance 99.8% of recorded time' (time-weighted) so it is not read as the sample-count Channel coverage table at src/fitdocs/render/sections.py:527-545; new criterion 8.12. (4) NotConfirmed renamed NotComputed throughout (training-load Amendment 3); routing unchanged. (5) The support question is asked upstream BEFORE the prompt flow; this calculator answers it as activity.sport in SUPPORTED_SPORTS and keeps compute's sport check as defence in depth; new criterion 2.7. [REPINNED 2026-07-26, design.md Amendment 2: this ruling originally said LoadCalculator gained a supports(activity) Protocol member. It did not -- training-load reversed that clause on measured grounds and deleted the declaration in 3121bb6, because a Protocol member would be mandatory for structural conformance under mypy --strict and every duck-typed calculator omitting it would raise AttributeError. The capability is unchanged and lives at the module-level supports_activity(calculator, activity), src/fitdocs/load/types.py:378, which finds a calculator's own optional off-Protocol supports by getattr. Criterion 2.7 is mechanism-neutral as written and is NOT amended; no criterion is renumbered or withdrawn.] The activity-blind required_athlete_fields() (a runner with no bicycle is still asked for a cycling FTP) is recorded as a KNOWN LIMITATION with its cause at AthleteFieldDeclaration, deferred by the user, not fixed. Finding 6 needed no change: Req 1.7 does not conflict with athlete-benchmarks' benchmark_age raising on a future-dated benchmark — this feature never calls it. Also corrected: the [load] reader is training-load's load_load_settings(document, settings_file) and its test module is tests/load/test_settings.py (was mis-stated as co-owned with athlete-benchmarks under tests/load/test_load_settings.py). Counts: criteria 82 (was 79; +2.7, +8.11, +8.12); design components 10 (was 11; -CalculatorConfigAccess); leaf tasks 13 (was 14; -1.3, no renumbering needed since 1.3 was last in its group). Mechanically re-verified: every criterion appears in design.md and in a task _Requirements_ line, no phantom IDs, every component claimed by exactly one implementation task _Boundary_ (5.1-5.3 re-cite components as read-only validation subjects), task numbering sequential, no dangling _Depends_, (P) waves disjoint. HARD PREREQUISITE for task 3.3: LoadContext -- SATISFIED, it landed in training-load. [REPINNED 2026-07-26: this prerequisite also named 'the supports protocol member', which is permanently unsatisfiable and was blocking nothing real. See ruling (5) above. Task 3.3 writes ThresholdCalculator.supports as designed; it must NOT be added to the LoadCalculator Protocol.]
